dct_title_s: Totius Lemouici et confinium provinciarum quantum ad dioecesin Lemouicensen spectant
dct_alternative_sm: Totivs Lemovici et confinium provinciarum quantum ad dioecesin Lemouicensen spectant
dct_description_sm: Bar scale on map given in "Scala miliarorum".
Decorative cartouches containing title, cartographer, dedication, and descriptive text.
Plan of Limoges at top right with key beneath and note to reader.
Signed in bottom left: Joachin Blanchon.
Appears in Bouguereau's Le theatre Francoys, 1594.
